plan.title: 名偵探柯南 (Detective Conan)
plan.summary: A tactical support/control hero who uses 'deduction' to mark enemies, applying debuffs and revealing hidden information. His ultimate creates a 'Crime Scene' zone that restricts movement and slows enemies while granting allies a 'Clue' buff.

slots.name: Logical Deduction
slots.purpose: Marking enemies for increased vulnerability and revealing their status.

slots.name: Truth Seeker
slots.purpose: Fire a tracking projectile that marks a target with a 'Clue'.

slots.name: Sleeping Pill
slots.purpose: Throw a tranquilizer that causes a brief stun and slows.

slots.name: Evidence Analysis
slots.purpose: Analyze a marked enemy to reduce their defense and increase damage taken by allies.

slots.name: Crime Scene Reconstruction
slots.purpose: Create a large zone that slows enemies and taunts them, while granting allies a speed boost.

slots.name: Final Deduction
slots.purpose: Instantly mark all enemies in a large radius, applying a heavy slow and revealing them.

champion.name: 名偵探柯南
champion.description: A master of deduction who traps enemies in a web of evidence. He controls the battlefield by marking targets and creating zones of restricted movement.

PASSIVE.name: Logical Deduction
PASSIVE.description: Every 3rd hit on an enemy marks them with a 'Clue', causing them to be Blinded for 1 second.

Q.name: Truth Seeker
Q.description: Fires a tracking bolt. If it hits, the target is marked and slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.

W.name: Sleeping Pill
W.description: Throws a tranquilizer. Enemies hit are stunned for 1.5 seconds and knocked back.

E.name: Evidence Analysis
E.description: Analyze a marked enemy to grant allies a 10% damage multiplier against that target.

R.name: Crime Scene Reconstruction
R.description: Creates a large zone for 6 seconds. Enemies inside are slowed by 50% and taunted. Allies inside gain a movement speed boost.

EX.name: Final Deduction
EX.description: Instantly marks all enemies in a large radius, applying a heavy slow and revealing them.
